title: Claude タブ React 構造改善 (TopBar 抽出 + ショートカット集約 + vestigial state cleanup)

planning_decisions.decision: Use ROADMAP.json sprint definition as-is. The sprint was pre-planned by the user with full Stories/AC/Tasks; no further plan-time autonomous edits needed.
planning_decisions.rationale: Sprint description is unusually detailed and includes a strict REGRESSION CONTRACT. Per DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority 0 (no skipping tests) and the sprint's own `自己判断スキップ禁止` rule, I will execute exactly the AC as specified rather than re-interpret them.

planning_decisions.decision: Skip both. The sprint description explicitly states: '構造改善のみ (機能追加なし) → gui-spec / prototype フェーズはスキップ'.
planning_decisions.rationale: User-facing changes are zero by design. There is no new GUI surface to spec or prototype.

planning_decisions.decision: Sequential (no worktree). Stories 2/3/4 all touch claude-agent-view.tsx — merge conflicts unavoidable.
planning_decisions.rationale: Sprint description explicitly recommends '逐次実行 (2 → 3 → 4)' for the same reason.

planning_decisions.decision: Adapt scripts/sprint-regression-baseline.sh (S43cfb1) into scripts/sprint-regression-S4b9df4.sh. Add INCLUDE_NEW flag to switch in the 5 new test files after Story 1.
planning_decisions.rationale: Existing infrastructure works and meets the AC. Per DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority 6 (existing assets > new implementation).

planning_decisions.decision: Create empty `{ "items": [] }` at sprint start; append items only when an item genuinely requires user judgement (per the sprint's batch-present rule).
planning_decisions.rationale: Sprint description explicitly says ユーザ判断は batch 提示 — do not escalate immediately.

implementation_decisions.decision: Add S0XX_BRANCH_ID env exports in regression script using first openBranch from running dev API
implementation_decisions.rationale: Tests hardcode pre-S1e8d02 branch IDs that no longer exist as worktrees. Updating each test individually = 6 files × ~300 lines, outside refactor scope. Override at regression-script layer is minimal-change and reusable.

implementation_decisions.decision: Truncate s006_add_dir_file.py to REST checks + composer + button visibility. Remove deleted attach-menu UI assertions.
implementation_decisions.rationale: S008 deleted the attach-menu UI per CLAUDE.md (S008 description). Test was vestigial. Keeping path-traversal REST checks preserves the still-valid security contract. wire-level addDirs test re-added in NUI-2 backlog.

implementation_decisions.decision: Update s017 to expect full DOM render (>= 1000 rows for 500 turns) + scroll perf <3000ms
implementation_decisions.rationale: Commit bed812b intentionally dropped react-window. Test was measuring removed behavior. New assertion matches the architectural decision in the commit.

implementation_decisions.decision: Add page.wait_for_function on filename .json suffix after radio click
implementation_decisions.rationale: useEffect-driven filename update is async; test was reading stale value. No production change.

implementation_decisions.topic: Mobile pencil/arrow tap area CSS fix
implementation_decisions.decision: Add explicit width/height + box-sizing border-box to .editPencil and .arrowBtn @media (max-width: 599px)
implementation_decisions.rationale: min-height alone was being collapsed by parent flex `align-items: flex-start`. Explicit width/height enforces 36x36 tap area per Apple HIG / Google MD3. Aligns with DESIGN_PRINCIPLES priority 10 (mobile parity).

implementation_decisions.decision: Accept 83 pre-existing lint errors as NUI-1 (batch-presented). Track delta to ensure refactor does not increase count.
implementation_decisions.rationale: Same stance as S43cfb1 final (85 errors). Fixing all 83 = scope explosion outside refactor target. Must NOT make worse.

review_decisions.decision: All 6 NUI items are blocking: false. The autopilot/sprint-auto context cannot interactively prompt the user, so the batch presentation is rendered in the sprint completion report (returned to the calling skill / user) and persisted in needs-user-input.json. The user can review and accept/reject each item in the post-sprint review.
review_decisions.rationale: Sprint description explicitly says: `blocking: true の項目があっても作業は止めず、 sprint 内で別 Task / 別 Story を継続。 sprint verify でまとめて提示`. All NUI items here are non-blocking (recommended path is documented for each); proceeding with sprint done is the documented behaviour.

review_decisions.decision: Sprint S4b9df4 status = done. All 5 stories complete (S4b9df4-0..4). All 22 E2E pass. Lint debt -6 (refactor net win). Bundle delta -180 bytes (well under +5% tolerance).
review_decisions.rationale: Master Regression Suite all-green at every gate (Story 0 baseline, Story 1, Story 2, Story 3, final). User-facing behaviour preserved (all 5 new E2E tests + 17 prior tests pass, manual-smoke surfaces covered automatically). Refactor goals achieved: claude-agent-view.tsx 654 → 413 lines (-37%), TopBar extracted, shortcuts unified, vestigial lift-up removed.
